posts.title: Off-brand cables are fine

posts.title: Fix a PC that won't boot to Windows

slides.text:
Fix a PC that won't boot to Windows
Unplug every USB device except keyboard and mouse
Unplug every USB device except keyboard and mouse
Power on and tap F8, or Shift+Restart to reach recovery
Run it twice — most boot loops die on the second pass
Still stuck? Boot to Safe Mode and uninstall recent drivers or updates.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Fix a PC that won't boot to Windows 🛠️

1. Unplug every USB device except keyboard and mouse
2. Power on and tap F8, or Shift+Restart to reach recovery
3. Troubleshoot > Advanced options > Startup Repair
4. Run it twice
     ✓ most boot loops die on the second pass
5. Still stuck? Boot to Safe Mode and uninstall recent drivers or updates.

Save this for the next ticket →
